title: blackthorn-events-communities-lightning-components.html
content: Add the Blackthorn Events Lightning Component to your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} to display a list or calendar of {{variable.Object_Event}} s or a dynamic {{variable.Object_Event}} ! Prerequisites This guide assumes you have already set up {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} . Custom Profiles Since the authorization process happens each time the Events app loads, the app looks for the following permissions instead of the user’s assigned profile name. It is essential for customers who use a custom System Admin profile instead of the Standard System Admin profile to include these settings in their custom profiles. Object User: Field User Type (UserType) = “Standard” ( Click here for more information about the User Type field.) Permissions System Permission: Modify all Data (Profile.PermissionsModifyAllData) = “True” (checked) Users: Manage Users (Profile.PermissionsManageUsers) = “True” (checked) Users: Manage Profiles and Permission Sets (Profile.PermissionsManageProfilesPermissionsets) = “True” (checked) Sharing Settings Please make sure Blackthorn {{variable.Object_Event}} and {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} objects have Default External Access set to "Public Read Only" or "Public Read/Write." If Sharing Settings are set to "Private", the Event page will not render in the Experience Cloud. Custom Domains If you currently have a custom domain for an Experience Cloud, you will need to allowlist the domain before the component will load. Please navigate to CSP Trusted Sites in Salesforce Setup to add your site name and URL ( Trusted Site URL = Experience Cloud URL). Lightning Locker If the Events {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} component is grayed out, your Lightning Locker is not enabled. To enable the Lightning Locker, complete the following steps. Go to the Experience Cloud and open Experience Builder. Click the Gear icon (Settings). Click the Security & Privacy tab. Set the Security Level to “Relaxed CSP: Permit Access to Inline Scripts and Allowed Hosts.” Set the Lightning Web Security to “On.” Configure the Blackthorn Events Component Drag and drop the " {{variable.Component_BTETListingLightComp}} " Lightning Component to a page. You are now ready to configure any of the following three scenarios. List/Calendar View of Events (Event Group)  Specific Event Dynamic Event URL Configure a List or Calendar View of Events The instructions below are for setting up a list or calendar view of an {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} . The {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} shows a group of available {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Define the {{variable.Field_Community_EventGroup}} . Only {{variable.Object_Event}} s associated to the {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} will be displayed on the component. To display all {{variable.Object_Event}} s, leave blank. Set the {{variable.Field_Community_CategoryFilter}} to display {{variable.Object_Event}} s by type. Example: Conference, Virtual Event, Brunch, etc. For {{variable.Field_Community_View}} , select {{variable.Picklist_ETGroup_UI_Calendar}} or {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_UI_List}} . Specify {{variable.Field_Community_Height}} ; the default is 500px. The {{variable.Field_Community_ClickBehavior}} field defines how to open the {{variable.Object_Event}} details. Enabling the {{variable.Field_Community_ShowMyEvents}} field will allow an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} to view the {{variable.Object_Event}} s they are registered for. If the {{variable.Field_Community_View}} = {{variable.Picklist_ETGrp_UI_List}} , then the user will also be able to filter "My Events" on the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} page when {{variable.Field_Community_ShowMyEvents}} is checked. Configure a Specific Event Only define the {{variable.Field_Community_Event}} field. Go to the {{variable.Object_Event}} page in Salesforce that you want to post in your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} . Click the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_EventURL}} link. Grab the last portion of the URL to load a single Event: "test-5a148A1cNyB/overview" Here is the full link for reference: https://events.blackthorn.io/en/8AHDeK6/test-5a148A1cNyB/overview Add the last portion (Ex. " test-5a148A1cNyB/overview" ) to the BT Events Listing on your site's component settings. Configure Registration Logic Use the registration logic for {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users to prevent blank {{variable.Object_Contact}} records from being created when the {{variable.Object_RelationshipSettings}} {{variable.Field_RelatSettin_ECUserDefCon}} field is checked. When true (checked), newly created {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will automatically be related to the logged-in user’s {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} {{variable.Object_Contact}} record. When false (unchecked), newly created {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s will be matched to an existing {{variable.Object_Contact}} or other {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} record. If a matching record isn’t found, a new record will only be created if the validation rules and required fields are compatible with the submitted {{variable.Object_Attendee}} data. Configure a Dynamic Event URL Use the Dynamic Event URL option to create a static {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} page that will dynamically load any {{variable.Object_Event}} . Open your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} in "Builder" mode and click the Settings icon at the top. Click New Page . Select a "Standard Page" in the pop-up menu. Add the Blackthorn Events component to the page. Set {{variable.Field_Community_EventGroup}} = "None" Set {{variable.Field_Community_View}} = "List"   Click your page, and you'll see the {{variable.Field_Community_URL}} field. This is used as part of the dynamic URL. Now, any {{variable.Object_Event}} you want to give to your {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s is a simple copy and paste. Here is the formatting for the URL to provide: <URL>?event=<event-id> Here is an example URL: https://yourdomain.force.com/s/blackthorn-events?event=a0w3i00000054tW Our suggestion would be to create the URL in a text formula field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object. Create a text formula field on the {{variable.Object_Event}} object. The formula will be: https://yourdomain.force.com/s/blackthorn-events?event= & Id Configure Person Accounts The {{variable.Product_Events}} app uses the mapped address field, {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailingAddress}} (PersonMailingAddress), for {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} s, including the following subfields: {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailingCity}} (PersonMailingCity) {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailingCountry}} (PersonMailingCountry) {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailPostalCode}} (PersonMailingPostalCode) {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailingStreet}} (PersonMailingStreet) You must use the {{variable.Field_PersonAct_MailingAddress}} (PersonMailingAddress) field (and its subfields) to ensure consistency and accuracy when configuring {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} s. Register Experience Cloud Users There are several steps that need to be completed before {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users can register. External users need to be able to access your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} and log in. You can find the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} documentation to enable this here . Once you complete the six steps in the {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} documentation, you are ready to log in as an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user! {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users who have login credentials will be able to log in and register for {{variable.Object_Event}} s. Register Other Users When logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} , users can now select a number of Tickets for an {{variable.Object_Event}} without having to add themselves as an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} . The user can then click {{variable.Button_Register}} to complete the registration process. New Field The {{variable.Field_Comm_DisableReqAddMyself}} field (checkbox) was added to the BT Event Listing component. The default setting is “True” or checked. When {{variable.Field_Comm_DisableReqAddMyself}} = “False” or unchecked, the user cannot register other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s without registering themselves. They must click the {{variable.Button_AddMyself}} button. When {{variable.Field_Comm_DisableReqAddMyself}} = "True" or checked, the user does not have to add themselves to register other {{variable.Object_Attendee}} s. Note regarding authenticated iframes: When a user registers for an Event via the authenticated iframe, the pre-fill functionality only applies to the main Ticket. Guest Tickets will no longer be pre-filled with the logged-in Attendee's information and will not have access to the Add Myself button, regardless of the BT Event Listing’s {{variable.Field_Comm_DisableReqAddMyself}} setting.  When using an authenticated iframe with the BT Event Listing {{variable.Field_Comm_DisableReqAddMyself}} = "True" (checked), registrants must select a Ticket for themselves.  Functionality The new field does not remove the restriction that the user must buy a primary Ticket ( {{variable.Object_EventItem}} {{variable.Field_ETEventItem_Type}} = “Main event ticket”) to buy a Guest Ticket. The change is that the primary Ticket does not have to be for the logged-in user. Additional functionality includes the following: If more than one {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is registered, they will be added to an {{variable.Object_AttendeeGroup}} . Clicking the {{variable.Button_AddMyself}} button will pre-fill the registration form for the logged-in user and add one to the quantity after the button is clicked. Register Non-Experience Cloud Users You may want to share your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} with guests as well as verified users. To do this is simple! Follow these easy steps. From your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} builder, navigate to "Settings," and click your Guest User Profile. Give the guest user access to the {{variable.PS_ET_CommunityGuestUser}} permission set. Make sure "Sharing Settings" are defined properly. To do this, navigate to Setup and search for "Sharing Settings". Set all Blackthorn Events Objects to Default External Access = "Public Read Only" or "Public Read/Write". Navigate to "Event Sharing Rules" and click {{variable.button_new}} . Recreate the settings below to allow access to view all {{variable.Object_Event}} s by default: Navigate to "Event Group Sharing Rules" and click {{variable.button_new}} . Recreate the settings below to allow access to view all {{variable.Object_EventGroup}} s by default: Now all guest users will be able to access the Blackthorn Events {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} component! Allow Users to View Your Experience Cloud The user you assign must have a profile that you assigned to access the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} . This will allow them to view the Blackthorn | Events Lightning Component. This can be found under Communities > Administration > Members > Available Profiles. Please make sure {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} users have the following permission sets assigned to them: For authorized users: {{variable.PS_ET_CommunityPlatformUser}} {{variable.PS_PT_CommunityPlatformUser}} or For guest users: {{variable.PS_ET_CommunityGuestUser}} Multilingual Events To control which language is displayed in the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} component, go to the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} user’s locale settings. This is found under User > Settings > My Personal Information > Language & Time. When the Events app is embedded in another website ( {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} etc.), the host website is responsible for setting the correct language code for the app. (The language code is in the Events app URL) This ensures the host can maintain the same language between the host and the Events app. If the host doesn’t set a language for the Events app, the language will match the source language, and there will be no translation. Use Cases: A specific language will load in the {{variable.Product_Events}} app.  The Events app’s language will follow the language of the host. In this case, the host has a language selector, and the {{variable.Product_Events}} app’s language will match the language of the host. Testing There are two ways to test the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} component for users. You can log in via the {{variable.Object_Contact}} , or sign in directly to the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} with the user's login credentials. Option 1: Navigate to the {{variable.Object_Contact}} record and click Log in to Experience as User . Option 2: Log in to your {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} using the user's login credentials. Click on the {{variable.Object_Event}} you want to register for. Click Add Myself . You will see all contact information pre-filled into the Attendee Form! If {{variable.Field_Community_ShowMyEvents}} is enabled from "Configure a List or Calendar View of Events" Step 6 for the Configuration in {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} , an {{variable.Object_Attendee}} will be able to view all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s they are registered for by clicking the "Heart" icon in the categories section. In this example, the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} has registered for "SDO - Blackthorn Conference," notice the heart icon is full. The following image shows all the {{variable.Object_Event}} s the {{variable.Object_Attendee}} is eligible to register for. Notice the heart icon is empty. FAQ: Q: My {{variable.Object_Event}} s aren't showing the changes I make in Salesforce; what gives? A: Salesforce Communities + Blackthorn takes some time to clear the cache and update the {{variable.Object_Event}} . Please wait approximately 15 minutes for this to happen. Please note, that using the Publish button in this scenario will not manually refresh the cache. Q: My Redirect URL is not working in the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} component. A: To fix this, add the redirection domain to CSP Trusted Sites on Salesforce (Setup > Security > CSP Trusted Sites). The redirection domain should have relaxed CSP rules or the parent domain (in this case https://*.force.com - for {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} ) needs to be added to the frame-ancestor rule. FAQ Q: Can I use a discount Code in the Experience Cloud? A: Yes, you can use discount {{variable.Object_Code}} s in the {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} if the following criteria are met. A user logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site as a {{variable.Object_Contact}} related to an {{variable.Object_Account}} can apply a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} if...  The {{variable.Object_Account}} is related to a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} . The {{variable.Object_Code}} ’s {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} field is set to “True.” A user logged into an {{variable.Feature_ExperienceCloud}} site as a {{variable.Object_Contact}} related to an {{variable.Object_Account}} cannot apply the discount {{variable.Object_Code}} if...  The {{variable.Object_Account}} is NOT connected to a discount {{variable.Object_Code}} . The {{variable.Object_Code}} ’s {{variable.Field_Code_RestrictToAccount}} field is set to “True.”
